        A numpy array representing acceleration as the result of applying the mathematical function to the inputs.

        x_array: Observational array of currents position.

        params_array: Tunable parameter arrays of previous equations.

    # Parameters for oscillator
    m = params_array[0] # Mass
    c = params_array[1] # Damping constant
    k = params_array[2] # Natural Spring Constant in Harmonic Motion

    B = params_array[4] # Further optimization and styling.
